title: Clerk.io - Modular ecommerce personalization and search platform
clean_text: Clerk.io is an AI-driven ecommerce personalization platform serving over 2,500 stores worldwide, offering modular tools including intelligent site search, product recommendations, email automation, and cookieless audience segmentation. Recommendations use pre-defined logic spanning hot products, seasonal trends, order history, click history, and cross-selling rules, configurable through a WYSIWYG drag-and-drop interface for placement on homepage, category, and checkout pages. Integrates with Magento, Shopify, Salesforce, and HubSpot via API. Targets small to mid-size ecommerce businesses, with Clerk.io claiming a 15-30% sales increase from personalized search and recommendations.
